reviews.title: I love this thing - a texture that's smooth as silk baby!
reviews.comment: I'd add a photo but my desk is a disaster. Been using the "pad" for about a month now. At first, my initial response was an instant "NOPE". By day 2 I was thinking, hmm, I kinda like it. By the end of the first week I was in love. The texture of it really is perfect, I've had other textured "hard" surface pads but none that were glass and that glass is responsible for a different feel that's hard to explain. Precision for gaming, working is perfect, the size is perfect. Only little things, it's NOT ergonomic, like, at all. It's a flat piece of glass. I don't use anything for my wrist, and at first, again, I think that's what kinda turned me off but I honestly don't notice it at this point. Second, it's actually glass and I thought for sure I broke it tossing my pocket knife up onto my desk as I've done a million times before. I got lucky, and I'll say it was a good hit and made a pretty lound glass clank, so props to "toughness" as well. I wouldn't want to test it again though. Overall, love it, grat product, would buy again.
reviews.author: Wheezy

reviews.comment: I love this glass mouse pad, the quality is great, I love the feel and Funtionality of this pad,  will not tear or fade or fall apart like normal pads Easy to clean the thickness if perfect, what a great value.
reviews.author: Rich Hardman

reviews.title: Perfect for sweaty hands
reviews.comment: Awesome glass mousepad not too slippery, I've had it for about year now and it's held up great! Super sturdy and feels way better than the typical hard plastic mousepad. If your palms sweat often while gaming it could ruin any cloth mousepad, so this is the perfect solution! Very good purchase
reviews.author: Bodrul B.

reviews.title: extremely well packaged, mouse moves smoothly
reviews.comment: The packaging is top-notch. 4 layers of protection ensures it does no come in damaged. The pad allows very smooth motion of the mouse, I got it at $10 and it is hard to believe it is that inexpensive. I have been using the $24 LANGBOHOS brand larger one for my primary computer. But my secondary computer has a keyboard/mouse drawer that is limited in size and this fits perfectly beside the keyboard and the length of the drawer. If you go with the LANGBOHOS brand, I like the white one better than the black one. The black one came in scratched on the bottom side. comes with the non-slip pads already installed. I prefer them not installed as sometimes I never use them, preferring to have the lower profile.
reviews.author: A. Stoner

reviews.title: glass mousepad that isnt low friction.
reviews.comment: It is a tempered glass pad that isn't low friction and the surface is not flat, it is textured.  I don't really recommend this for FPS gamers, I was expecting something more like the steelseries icemat which is smooth and low friction. But the price was good I guess.
